title: Morphisms of couples give morphisms of spectral sequences
statement: Let $(D,E,\alpha,f,g)$ and $(D',E',\alpha',f',g')$ be exact couples [def-sp-exact-couple] in the same abelian category. A morphism of exact couples is a pair of maps $t_D:D\to D'$ and $t_E:E\to E'$ preserving bidegrees and satisfying $t_D\alpha=\alpha't_D$, $t_Df=f't_E$, and $t_Eg=g't_D$. Such a morphism induces, for every $r$, a morphism $E_r\to E'_r$ of the spectral sequences, compatible with the differentials. If both couples satisfy the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], then for every total degree $n$ the map $t_D:D^{0,n}\to D'^{0,n}$ of their canonical abutments respects the filtrations [def-sp-filtration] constructed there, and the induced map $\operatorname{gr}^pA^n\to\operatorname{gr}^pA'^n$ on the associated graded pieces is, under the identifications $E_\infty^{p,n-p}\cong\operatorname{gr}^pA^n$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], the map $E_\infty\to E'_\infty$ [def-sp-convergence] induced by $t_E$.

proof.text: By [lem-sp-derived-couple-functoriality], the compatible maps on the derived couples iterate to maps on every $E_r$ commuting with $d_r$, and induce a map on $E_\infty$ through $Z_\infty/B_\infty$.

Under the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], the abutment in total degree $n$ is $A^n=D^{0,n}$ and its filtration is $F^pA^n=G_{n-p}A^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to D^{0,n})$ for $0\leq p\leq n$ (and $F^pA^n=A^n$ for $p\leq0$, $F^pA^n=0$ for $p>n-a$ by the vanishing of $D^{p,n-p}$). Commutation with every power of $\alpha$ gives $t_D^{0,n}(F^pA^n)\subseteq F'^pA'^n$, so $t_D^{0,n}$ is filtration preserving.

The associated graded map of a filtration-preserving morphism is obtained by restricting to each $F^p$ and passing to the quotient by $F^{p+1}$. By [lem-sp-half-plane-graded-canonical], for $q=n-p$ the identification $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong\operatorname{gr}^pA^n$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence] is induced by the two epimorphisms $\gamma:D^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}$ (from $g$) and $\varphi:D^{p,q}\to\operatorname{gr}^pA^n$ (from $\alpha^p$), which have the same kernel; likewise for the primed couple. For $y\in D^{p,q}$, $t_D\alpha^py=\alpha'^pt_Dy$ and $t_Egy=g't_Dy$, so $\operatorname{gr}(t_D)\circ\varphi=\varphi'\circ t_D$ and $t_\infty\circ\gamma=\gamma'\circ t_D$, where $t_\infty$ is the map on $E_\infty=Z_\infty/B_\infty$ [def-sp-convergence] from Step 1 [lem-sp-derived-couple-functoriality]. Since $\varphi$ is an epimorphism, $\operatorname{gr}(t_D)$ corresponds to $t_\infty$ under the identifications.
